def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    entity_ids = list(entity_ids)
    base = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name='product_id'))

    # ---- Pre-aggregate payments to order level (only payments known by seed_time) ----
    pay = db['payments']
    pay = pay[pay['ts'] < seed_time]
    order_payments = pay.groupby('order_id').agg(
        total_payment=('payment_value', 'sum'),
        avg_payment_installments=('payment_installments', 'mean'),
        n_payment_types=('payment_type', 'nunique'),
        has_credit_card=('payment_type', lambda x: float((x == 'credit_card').any())),
        has_boleto=('payment_type', lambda x: float((x == 'boleto').any())),
        has_voucher=('payment_type', lambda x: float((x == 'voucher').any())),
    ).reset_index()

    # ---- Pre-aggregate reviews to order level (only reviews written by seed_time) ----
    rev = db['reviews']
    rev = rev[rev['review_creation_date'] <= seed_time]
    order_reviews = rev.groupby('order_id').agg(
        avg_review_score=('review_score', 'mean'),
        min_review_score=('review_score', 'min'),
        num_reviews=('review_score', 'count'),
        share_positive=('review_score', lambda x: (x >= 4).mean()),
    ).reset_index()

    # ---- Orders known by seed_time (purchase happened before seed_time) ----
    orders = db['orders']
    orders = orders[orders['order_purchase_timestamp'] < seed_time].copy()
    # Delivery info is only known if delivery actually happened before seed_time
    delivered_mask = orders['order_delivered_customer_date'].notna() & \
                     (orders['order_delivered_customer_date'] <= seed_time)
    orders['delivery_delay_days'] = np.where(
        delivered_mask,
        (orders['order_delivered_customer_date'] - orders['order_estimated_delivery_date']).dt.days,
        np.nan
    )
    orders['is_delivered'] = delivered_mask.astype(float)
    orders['is_canceled'] = orders['order_status'].isin(['canceled', 'unavailable']).astype(float)
    # Estimated delay (known at purchase time, no leakage)
    orders['est_delivery_days'] = (
        orders['order_estimated_delivery_date'] - orders['order_purchase_timestamp']
    ).dt.days

    # ---- Order items for target products, purchased before seed_time ----
    items = db['order_items']
    items = items[items['product_id'].isin(entity_ids) & (items['ts'] < seed_time)].copy()

    items_full = items.merge(
        orders[['order_id', 'is_delivered', 'is_canceled', 'delivery_delay_days', 'est_delivery_days']],
        on='order_id', how='left'
    ).merge(order_payments, on='order_id', how='left').merge(order_reviews, on='order_id', how='left')

    def agg_window(df, suffix):
        if df.empty:
            return pd.DataFrame(index=base.index)
        g = df.groupby('product_id')
        out = pd.DataFrame({
            f'units_{suffix}': g['order_item_id'].count(),
            f'num_orders_{suffix}': g['order_id'].nunique(),
            f'revenue_{suffix}': g['price'].sum(),
            f'freight_{suffix}': g['freight_value'].sum(),
            f'avg_price_{suffix}': g['price'].mean(),
            f'avg_freight_{suffix}': g['freight_value'].mean(),
            f'days_since_last_sale_{suffix}': g['ts'].apply(lambda x: (seed_time - x.max()).days),
            f'days_since_first_sale_{suffix}': g['ts'].apply(lambda x: (seed_time - x.min()).days),
            f'delivered_rate_{suffix}': g['is_delivered'].mean(),
            f'cancel_rate_{suffix}': g['is_canceled'].mean(),
            f'avg_delivery_delay_{suffix}': g['delivery_delay_days'].mean(),
            f'avg_est_delivery_{suffix}': g['est_delivery_days'].mean(),
            f'avg_payment_{suffix}': g['total_payment'].mean(),
            f'avg_installments_{suffix}': g['avg_payment_installments'].mean(),
            f'credit_card_rate_{suffix}': g['has_credit_card'].mean(),
            f'boleto_rate_{suffix}': g['has_boleto'].mean(),
            f'avg_review_{suffix}': g['avg_review_score'].mean(),
            f'min_review_{suffix}': g['min_review_score'].mean(),
            f'num_reviews_{suffix}': g['num_reviews'].sum(),
            f'share_pos_reviews_{suffix}': g['share_positive'].mean(),
        })
        return out

    days_before = (seed_time - items_full['ts']).dt.days if not items_full.empty else pd.Series(dtype=float)
    w1 = items_full[days_before <= 90]
    w2 = items_full[(days_before > 90) & (days_before <= 180)]
    w3 = items_full[(days_before > 180) & (days_before <= 360)]
    older = items_full[days_before > 360]

    features = base.join(agg_window(w1, 'w1')).join(agg_window(w2, 'w2')) \
                   .join(agg_window(w3, 'w3')).join(agg_window(older, 'older'))

    # ---- Global history features ----
    if not items_full.empty:
        g = items_full.groupby('product_id')
        hist = pd.DataFrame({
            'total_units': g['order_item_id'].count(),
            'total_orders': g['order_id'].nunique(),
            'total_revenue': g['price'].sum(),
            'avg_price': g['price'].mean(),
            'days_since_last_sale': g['ts'].apply(lambda x: (seed_time - x.max()).days),
            'days_since_first_sale': g['ts'].apply(lambda x: (seed_time - x.min()).days),
            'avg_review': g['avg_review_score'].mean(),
            'num_reviews': g['num_reviews'].sum(),
            'cancel_rate': g['is_canceled'].mean(),
            'avg_delivery_delay': g['delivery_delay_days'].mean(),
        })
        features = features.join(hist)
    else:
        for c in ['total_units', 'total_orders', 'total_revenue', 'avg_price',
                  'days_since_last_sale', 'days_since_first_sale', 'avg_review',
                  'num_reviews', 'cancel_rate', 'avg_delivery_delay']:
            features[c] = np.nan

    features['has_history'] = features['total_units'].notna().astype(float)

    # ---- Derived trend / ratio features ----
    eps = 1e-6
    features['units_growth_w1_w2'] = (features['units_w1'] - features['units_w2']) / (features['units_w2'] + eps)
    features['units_growth_w2_w3'] = (features['units_w2'] - features['units_w3']) / (features['units_w3'] + eps)
    features['revenue_growth_w1_w2'] = (features['revenue_w1'] - features['revenue_w2']) / (features['revenue_w2'] + eps)
    features['aov_w1'] = features['revenue_w1'] / (features['num_orders_w1'] + eps)
    features['aov_w2'] = features['revenue_w2'] / (features['num_orders_w2'] + eps)
    features['freight_ratio_w1'] = features['freight_w1'] / (features['revenue_w1'] + eps)
    features['success_rate_w1'] = features['delivered_rate_w1']
    features['success_rate_w2'] = features['delivered_rate_w2']
    features['sales_accel_w1'] = features['units_w1'] / (features['days_since_first_sale_w1'] + 1.0)

    # ---- Fill NaNs ----
    features['days_since_last_sale'] = features['days_since_last_sale'].fillna(9999)
    features['days_since_last_sale_w1'] = features['days_since_last_sale_w1'].fillna(9999)
    features['days_since_last_sale_w2'] = features['days_since_last_sale_w2'].fillna(9999)
    features['days_since_last_sale_w3'] = features['days_since_last_sale_w3'].fillna(9999)
    features['days_since_last_sale_older'] = features['days_since_last_sale_older'].fillna(9999)
    features['days_since_first_sale'] = features['days_since_first_sale'].fillna(9999)
    num_cols = features.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns
    features[num_cols] = features[num_cols].fillna(0.0)

    features = features.reindex(entity_ids)
    return features.astype(float)
